cards.name: strike_regent
cards.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 ORIGINAL strike_regent is EDIT TARGET and preservation master. Image2 is earlier inserted P3R sword design reference ONLY, rejected because too flat and crude. Locally replace ONLY original sword with same slender Makoto Yuki P3R straight single-edge sword design, hilt upperleft tip lowerright same overall position, simple crossguard dark wrapped grip. Preserve ALL original purple/magenta/oxblood background shapes, colors, gold slash fragments, gold sparkles and warm aura unchanged as closely as possible. No hand, person or extra motifs.
CRITICAL finish and shadows: original sword has large bold near-black underside planes against warm ivory/gold lit planes. Match that strong 3D readability in new sword. Blade must have a broad silver lit main face, one crisp narrow near-black side plane along lower-left edge, a separate steel-grey bevel, bright thin warm ivory sharpened cutting edge; clear thickness, taper and a physically coherent ridge. Avoid a flat white triangular strip. Crossguard is solid gunmetal with visible TOP silver plane, charcoal FRONT plane, nearblack UNDERSIDE and sharply defined occlusion at blade collar. Small metal collar with recessed dark seam. Grip has carefully drawn alternating overlapping dark leather wrapping bands, subtle edge highlights, narrow recess shadows; silver pommel visibly faceted with black underside, small join ring and restrained amber reflection. Keep these details readable, not ornate fantasy filigree, no needless extra accessories. Confident original-style ink silhouette, rich hard-edged celshaded planes and clear highlights, smoothly resolved bevel contours, no rough sketch. Gold aura must sit outside sword and not wash out dark planes: retain strong BLACK, grey, silver, ivory value separation similar to image1. Original dramatic orange-gold atmosphere and exact scene preserved. No generic blue redraw or backdrop simplification. Opaque horizontal1000x760 fullbleed no text border watermark.
